NAME: ALERT_DEFAULT
DESCRIPTION: SO23 shared lists when ALERT_<route> is blank (comma list)

NAME: ALERT_ESCALATION_WINDOW_H
DESCRIPTION: Escalation look-back window of an alert rule (hours)

NAME: ALERT_EXC_APP_LINK
DESCRIPTION: Exceptions app link in the alert e-mail (blank = app name)

NAME: ALERT_MAIL_RENDERER
DESCRIPTION: Alert e-mail renderer: SMTG (built-in fallback) or BUILTIN

NAME: ALERT_SECTION_CLASS
DESCRIPTION: Consumer section of the alert message (blank = none)

NAME: ALERT_TEMPLATE_DEFAULT
DESCRIPTION: Generic alert e-mail template (rule and channel name none)

NAME: ALERT_TIME_ZONE
DESCRIPTION: Time zone of the times in the alert e-mail (TTZZ)

NAME: CHECK_STALE_MIN_DEFAULT
DESCRIPTION: Area dashboard: a run older than this is stale (minutes)

NAME: CONTROL_TEAMS
DESCRIPTION: Teams a control may name (control register; comma list)

NAME: CONTROL_TIME_ZONE
DESCRIPTION: Time zone of business date and review cut-off (TTZZ)

NAME: EXC_REASON_CODES
DESCRIPTION: Reason codes of an open exception (classification)

NAME: JOB_CHILD_MSG_IDS
DESCRIPTION: Job log messages naming a released job (MSGID/MSGNO list)

NAME: JOB_CHILD_MSG_PCRE
DESCRIPTION: PCRE of such a line: group 1 job name, group 2 job count

NAME: JOB_CLAIMS
DESCRIPTION: Claim classes of other monitors (ZIF_CA_OPS_JOB_CLAIM)

NAME: JOB_ENRICHERS
DESCRIPTION: Enricher classes in order (ZIF_CA_OPS_JOB_ENRICHER)

NAME: JOB_EVENT_IDS
DESCRIPTION: Events whose parameter names the predecessor job

NAME: JOB_EXCLUDE_PCRE
DESCRIPTION: Job names never reported (PCRE list, complete name)

NAME: JOB_LOG_ERROR_TYPES
DESCRIPTION: Job log message types that count as an error

NAME: JOB_LOG_PROGRAMS
DESCRIPTION: Programs whose finished jobs get their job log checked

NAME: JOB_LONG_RUNNING_MIN
DESCRIPTION: Minutes active before a job is long-running

NAME: JOB_LOOKBACK_MIN
DESCRIPTION: Minutes read back by the first run (no watermark)

NAME: JOB_MAX_APPLOGS
DESCRIPTION: Application logs linked per failed job

NAME: JOB_MAX_CHILDREN
DESCRIPTION: Children of a failing job's parent kept as context

NAME: JOB_MAX_DEPTH
DESCRIPTION: Ancestors followed upwards from a failed job

NAME: JOB_MAX_JOBS
DESCRIPTION: Jobs read per run and kind (cap)

NAME: JOB_MAX_LOG_READS
DESCRIPTION: Job logs read per run (detection, links, evidence)

NAME: JOB_MAX_MESSAGES
DESCRIPTION: Error lines of a job log kept per job

NAME: JOB_NOT_STARTED_MIN
DESCRIPTION: Minutes after the planned start a released job may wait

NAME: JOB_OVERLAP_MIN
DESCRIPTION: Minutes re-read before the watermark

NAME: JOB_PARENT_FIELDS
DESCRIPTION: TBTCO fields of parent job name and count (two names)

NAME: JOB_PARENT_PROGRAMS
DESCRIPTION: Programs of jobs that may start children (blank = any)

NAME: JOB_RESOLVERS
DESCRIPTION: Parent / child resolvers in order (ZIF_CA_OPS_JOB_RESOLVER)

NAME: JOB_WAITING_STATUSES
DESCRIPTION: Job statuses of a job waiting to start

NAME: PURGE_PACKAGE_SIZE
DESCRIPTION: Rows deleted per purge package

NAME: RETENTION_DAYS_ALERT_LOG
DESCRIPTION: Retention of alert log rows (days; at least 30 applied)

NAME: RETENTION_DAYS_JOB_EVIDENCE
DESCRIPTION: Retention of SAP job evidence (days; >= 30)

NAME: RETENTION_DAYS_REVIEW
DESCRIPTION: Retention of daily control sign-offs (days; >= 30)

NAME: RETENTION_DAYS_RUN
DESCRIPTION: Retention of runs and findings (days; >= 30)

NAME: SLA_DAYS_DEFAULT
DESCRIPTION: SLA days of an exception when SLA_DAYS_<area>_<sev> blank
